response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination) AS share FROM counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: An ID means a non-NULL ID appearing in Examination; the total includes all Examination records.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every Patient ID, including patients with no Examination records, when calculating the average share.
alternatives.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.ID, COUNT(e.ID) AS record_count FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination), 0) AS share FROM counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE share > average_share
